result.freshness_policy: live: each search reads Gmail through gog; scope_query defines the mail corpus, while browse, recency, and pagination boundaries report partial coverage

browse_query.description: Gmail query used when Recall supplies an empty query.

debug_stall_ms.description: Artificial pre-search delay for cancellation conformance tests.

gog_binary.description: Path to gog. Empty means gog on PATH.

max_candidates.description: Maximum candidates returned by one Gmail search.

newer_than_days.description: Optional recency boundary added to every search; zero is unbounded.

replay.description: Recorded gog fixture directory used by conformance tests; relative paths resolve from base_dir.

scope_query.description: Gmail query fragment ANDed into every search; this defines the source corpus.

timeout_ms.description: Maximum duration of one gog invocation; the request deadline may shorten it.
